text: The initial commit removes a project-specific false override while keeping by-project/default:true. A separate follow-up replaces that keyed shape with scalar dontbuild:true, which the fixed kind retains. ignore-closed-tree is a separate setting, with a later ESR branch name. The selected kind delegates to Gecko transforms; neither a same-named comm helper nor the decision DONTBUILD flag establishes that imported worker/schema contract. No taskgraph or build execution proved an outcome.
title: The l10n bump edits separate the dontbuild value from its configuration shape
